payload.acceptance_criteria: When markdown sits under a gitignored path, the markdownlint hook shall skip it and still refuse tracked markdown that breaks a rule.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When a gitignored folder such as .basicly/usage holds a .venv with vendored markdown, I want a commit that stages a markdown file to lint only repository markdown, so I can commit without failures from files Git never tracks.

## Steps to Reproduce

Create .basicly/usage/x/.venv/pkg/README.md with trailing spaces under the gitignored .basicly/usage folder, stage any markdown file and commit. The markdownlint hook reports MD009 for the ignored file and refuses the commit.

## Confirmation Plan

Run the regression test that lints a tree holding a gitignored bad markdown file with the repository config, then remove the ignore and expect MD009.
payload.requirements: Fix the repository config; keep the hook enabled.
payload.title: Markdownlint hook lints gitignored markdown
